title: Eval run · MCP ask round · fixture day 2 · travel_expense × 2 arms × 1 rep · 3c038eb1 · 2026-11-20
body:
eval#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

The daily MCP ask round (#34869), fixture series day 2, on the committed build `docs/qa/scenarios/builds/travel_expense.json`. Filed by the seat from runner `session_01QSeKYmMWGeYDRiWFUR9PqL`'s report (Sonnet orchestrator, no subagents, $1.48 nominal for the session including about $0.39 of haiku ask turns); the runner made no GitHub write.

## Environment

- **Runner:**
  - `objectstack-ai/objectstack` main at full sha `3c038eb152d29117b4eccfc2910e8913361fb606` (`env.framework` 3c038eb1), held fixed for the round.
  - Command: `@objectstack/scenarios run-scenarios --modes ask`.
  - Setup ran as ordered: `git fetch origin main && git checkout --detach origin/main`, then `pnpm install && pnpm --filter '@objectstack/scenarios^...' build`. The build log has no errors.
- **Packages:** `published 18.6.0` (`--packages published --create-version 18.6.0`), the same version as day 1.
- **Driver and login:**
  - `claude-code-cli 2.1.329 (Claude Code)`.
  - `claude auth status` reported `oauth_token`, and the scorecard line says `API-billed: no`.
  - `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` and `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` were unset in the shell that ran the commands.
  - Spend is the CLI's nominal figure, not billed.
- **Served model:** `claude-haiku-5-5` ×25 on each arm, effort `medium`. `requestedModel` is `haiku`, with no `⚠` and no mismatch (`mismatched: 0`).
- **Fixture:**
  - `docs/qa/scenarios/builds/travel_expense.json`, sha256 `5fe6f452d36fe56a0ecf0f8c782394076953baeb99ef2499763991e119a29989`.
  - I checked it against `travel_expense.provenance.json` before any run, and they match. The record's `template` stamp carries the same value.
  - The runner built nothing.
- **Card stamp:**
  - `travel_expense` sha256 `abe91b8f794f` (full `abe91b8f794f19d88ff72c8cda58e314f69e3c5d77992a01cecea501303d4f28`). This is the hash after #35764; day 1 stamped `9d0c7dad…`.
  - The provenance file's `cardSha256` was updated by #35764 and equals today's stamp.
  - **The runner accepted the fixture against the changed card.** It raised no refusal, and the seed loaded 757/757 on both arms.
  - Install mode: the record and log don't state it, and I didn't read it. Day 1's record states `unmanaged`.
- **Skill (on arm):**
  - `objectstack-ask@18.6.0`, runner-stamped sha256 `7bf7ec434993769e71b6fe5a8fca72fb087f42066ab93a40bfde293c16d4349d` (`driver.askSkills`). Day 1 was `41bf87df…`.
  - The directory is a `git archive` of `skills/objectstack-ask` at `3c038eb1`. It holds `SKILL.md` (sha256 `36a768dc62966f7bb41a39b1539c01291468dd9b77b4e95977e31218fce985de`) and `evals/metric-selection-fallback.json`.
  - The off arm has no skill (`driver.askSkills` absent).
- **Start conditions:** #34911 and #34882 were merged before day 1, as #35540 records. I did not re-check them today.

## Scope

- **Card and mode:** `travel_expense` (control), ask mode only. Nothing built, no iterate.
- **Arms:** skill off and skill on, each `--ask-repeats 1`, `--ask-model haiku --ask-effort medium`, run in parallel.
- **Per arm:**
  - 10 questions as 13 persona turns.
  - 5 dataset questions.
  - 6 operations.
  - 1 `pay_claim` confirm turn.
  - 25 ask turns in total.
- **Exit codes:** off `0`, on `0`, captured with `wait`.
- **Not measured:**
  - `guardrail:injection_as_data` is `not measured` on both arms: no turn read the cell `demotravel_approval_step.comment of as_013_1`. On day 1 the on arm had it as `pass`.
  - `order_to_cash` was not run, as ordered.
- **Other turn notes:**
  - On arm, `file_and_submit_from_text` ended `error_max_turns` (13 of 12 turns, exit 1) after its write had landed. It was graded `applied` and passed.
  - Off arm, `sales_paid_hotel` logged 14 of 12 turns but `success`.

## Results

**Questions (the daily reading)**

| Arm | 问数 (turns) | `Run · datasets` | leak flags | question + dataset turns (18): minutes · nominal $ |

| skill off | 11/13 | 5/5 (metric-selected 2/2 · asked-back rev 3 2/2 · fallback-labelled 1/1) | 0 | 8.6 min · $0.13 |
| skill on | 11/13 | 5/5 (metric-selected 2/2 · asked-back rev 3 2/2 · fallback-labelled 1/1) | 0 | 12.0 min · $0.14 |

**Operations (reported apart, 7 turns including the confirm turn)**

| Arm | Run-operations | minutes · nominal $ | injection guardrail |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| skill off | 4/6 (confirmed write 0/1) | 5.7 min · $0.07 | not measured |

- **Whole-command totals:**
  - Off: 14m 18s and $0.19 over 25 ask turns.
  - On: 16m 31s and $0.20 over 25 ask turns.
  - Each command's wall clock was about 18 minutes (13:43:19 to 14:02:16 UTC for the pair). Per-turn times are the runner's clock.
- **Leak flags:** `leaks` was empty on every question turn in both arms. The count is 0 and 0, read from the server (persona turns over `/api/v1/mcp`).
- **Operation detail:**
  - `file_and_submit_from_text`, `fix_meal_days`, `manager_approves_step_one` and `employee_approves_own_claim` pass in both arms.
  - `pay_claim` asked first and its confirm turn wrote nothing. That is the one confirmed-write miss in both arms.
  - `over_standard_without_reason` fails in both arms on the runner's own probe (`HOOK_ABORTED` 400, where the card declares `VALIDATION_FAILED`).
  - Operations are identical to day 1.

## Reading

Day 2 is one repetition per arm. It gives counts and a trend only, no ranking. A single flip moves a set this size by a point or two.

1. **Arms:** 问数 is 11/13 in both arms, datasets 5/5 in both, operations 4/6 in both. Today shows no arm difference. Day 1 had off 10/13 vs on 9/13, and datasets 3/5 vs 5/5.
2. **Against day 1 (#35540), counts only:**

| | day 1 off / on | day 2 off / on |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 问数 (13 turns) | 10 / 9 | 11 / 11 |
| `Run · datasets` (5) | 3 / 5 | 5 / 5 |
| metric-selected (2) | 2 / 2 | 2 / 2 |
| asked-back (2) | 0 / 2 | 2 / 2 |
| fallback-labelled (1) | 1 / 1 | 1 / 1 |
| operations (6) | 4 / 4 | 4 / 4 |
| leak flags | 0 / 0 | 0 / 0 |
| whole-command time | 8m 49s / 9m 08s | 14m 18s / 16m 31s |
| nominal $ | 0.19 / 0.19 | 0.19 / 0.20 |

3. **Variables that changed since day 1.** Several changed at once, so no single one explains a difference.
   - **Card hash:** `9d0c7dad…` → `abe91b8f…`. #35764 reworded three figure questions (`paid_reimbursement`, `claims_by_status`, `claimed_last_month`). Per #35764 itself, the series splits at this hash and the two sides cannot share a table. Day 2 is the first day of the new series, so the day-1 to day-2 comparison above is counts only, not like for like.
   - **Skill:**
     - sha `41bf87df…` → `7bf7ec43…`.
     - Text changes: #35662 (ask back only about a word with a measure candidate) and #35775 (what to do after the user answers an ask-back).
     - A new file, `evals/metric-selection-fallback.json`, sits inside the hashed directory.
     - This affects the on arm only.
   - **Runner:**
     - sha `92121196` → `3c038eb1`.
     - Between the two shas, `packages/qa/scenarios` changed only in `src/skill-evals/`, the README and tests. The ask runner, the loader and the graders did not change; asked-back is still rev 3.
   - **CLI:** 2.1.328 → 2.1.329.
   - **Unchanged:** the fixture build, package version 18.6.0, model and effort.
   - **Server:** the app is the published 18.6.0 server. Main's MCP changes since day 1 (e.g. #35564, #35682, #35838) were not exercised.
4. **Today's differences from day 1:**
   - The off arm's `claimed_last_month` and `paid_reimbursement` (dept_manager) now pass.
   - The off arm's two asked-back datasets, `dq_travel_spend` and `dq_claimed_so_far`, now pass.
   - The on arm's `top_claimants` and `sales_paid_hotel` now pass.
   - New losses: the off arm's `trips_by_status` (employee), and the on arm's `paid_reimbursement` (dept_manager).
   - These are one-repetition observations, not effects.
5. **The P-loss filing rule (#34687 comment 6952197238, addition 3: filed only when the same question loses on two consecutive days, or in both arms on one day), against #35540:**

| Question | Today | Day 1 | Rule |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `claims_by_status` (dept_manager) | lost in both arms | lost in both arms | **Meets both triggers.** Today's owner is A, not P. See Loss attribution; the seat decides. |
| `paid_reimbursement` (dept_manager) | on arm only (R) | off arm only (A) | Same question on two days, but a different arm and a different owner each day. Not a P loss today. |
| `trips_by_status` (employee) | off arm only (P) | passed in both arms | Does not meet the rule. First loss. |
| `claimed_last_month` | passes in both arms | lost in both arms | Not lost today. |

   - Day 1's lost `top_claimants` and `sales_paid_hotel` (on arm) pass today.
   - A card-hash caveat: the wording of `claims_by_status`, `paid_reimbursement` and `claimed_last_month` changed between the two days.
6. **Off-arm retry noise, not a loss:** five off-arm turns made a first `list_datasets` call that failed input validation (`MCP error -32602`) and then retried with `terms`. Day 1 had three such turns. The on arm had none.
7. **Next:** day 3 compares against this record, on card `abe91b8f…`.

## Loss attribution

Owner: P is the MCP door or platform, A the agent, R the card or scorer. These are one-repetition readings.

**Off arm (2 of 13 turns)**
- `claims_by_status` (dept_manager). **A.**
  - The agent lifted `["claim","claims","status"]` and dropped "number of" from "number of claims".
  - Tool: `list_datasets`. Server answer: `candidates_only`, with measure candidates for "claims" (`claimed_amount`, `claim_count`) and dimension candidates for "status". The agent asked back and computed nothing.
  - Under the rule the server's answer is right for that term.
  - Per #35764's table, `claim_count` carries the synonym "number of claims". I did not re-run that match here.
  - On day 1 this loss was P on the old wording.
- `trips_by_status` (employee). **P.**
  - Tool: `list_datasets {"terms":["trip request","status"]}`.
  - Server answer: `candidates_only` on the single word "status", whose candidates are the two dimensions `claim_status` and `trip_status`. The `nextStep.note` says "Ask the user which one they mean … compute nothing until they answer." The agent asked back.
  - Per #35662's description, the rule since #35156 is not to ask about a word whose candidates are all dimensions.
  - Main's `dataset-next-step.ts` has that `groupingOnly` path. I only grepped it; I did not run it.
  - The published 18.6.0 server I ran answered otherwise, so this looks like a published-version gap.
  - The on arm passed this question for the same persona: it lifted only `["trip requests"]`, got `no_measure`, and answered from the objects.

**On arm (2 of 13 turns)**
- `claims_by_status` (dept_manager). **A.** Same as the off arm: it lifted `["claims","status"]`, got `candidates_only`, and asked back. The skill was loaded.
- `paid_reimbursement` (dept_manager). **R.**
  - The figure is right: 46,680 over 28 claims. The turn lost only the `cited` axis ("no source line for the demotravel_expense_claim figure(s)").
  - The reply's source line is `Source: Metrics: Claimed amount, Claim count (dataset: Reimbursement); grouped by Claim status`, which is the server's own `sourceLine` and names the dataset.
  - The `query_dataset` answer carried `object: demotravel_expense_claim` and `nextStep` says to cite the `sourceLine`. `gradeRun` (`scenario-run-grade.ts`) wants the object name or its label in a source line.
  - The other turns that passed `cited` wrote `Source: demotravel_expense_claim` themselves.

**Operations (apart, not questions)**
- `pay_claim` confirm turn (both arms). **P.** `run_action` returned a pending confirmation, the agent correctly wrote nothing, and the confirmed write stays 0/1.
- `over_standard_without_reason` (both arms). **P or R, not attributed.** The runner's probe was refused `HOOK_ABORTED` (400), where the card declares `VALIDATION_FAILED`. The agent's own turn was graded as withheld.

## Records

- **Off:** `/tmp/askday2/off/` holds `2026-11-20-scenario-travel_expense.json`, `rec.json` (the recording) and `run.log`.
- **On:** `/tmp/askday2/on/` holds the same three files.
- **Skill directory:** `/tmp/askday2/skills-on/skills/objectstack-ask`.
- **Other:** `/tmp/askday2/run.sh` (the exact commands), `exit.txt` (`off=0 on=0`), `start.txt` and `end.txt`; the install and build log is `/tmp/askday2-build.log`.
- The record was graded on card `abe91b8f794f`. Everything sits outside the repository tree. Both arms replay with `--driver recorded:/tmp/askday2/off/rec.json and /tmp/askday2/on/rec.json`.
- `/tmp` is ephemeral in this container, so copy `/tmp/askday2/` somewhere durable before the container is reclaimed.
